What is libretro-uae-git?

PUAE-libretro is a work-in-progress port of the Amiga emulator UAE (based on WinUAE 5.3.1) to the libretro API, so RetroArch can boot and run classic Amiga software. It reads standard Amiga disk formats (ADF, ADZ, IPF, DMS, FDI), hard drive images, and CDs, with support for WHDLoad game packages, multi-disk M3U playlists, and remappable virtual-keyboard controls. It is a backend emulation core with no interface of its own.

Install libretro-uae-git on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add libretro-uae-git

Good to know

  • Kickstart ROM files matching specific MD5 checksums for the Amiga model being emulated (A500, A1200, A4000, CD32, etc.) — not included
  • RetroArch installed to load the core
  • External CAPSIMG library for IPF copy-protected disk support
